install:
command -v rclone >/dev/null 2>&1 || curl -fsSL https://rclone.org/install.sh | sudo bash
if [ -f scripts/sync_gdrive.sh ]; then GDRIVE_SHARED_WITH_ME="${GDRIVE_SHARED_WITH_ME:-1}" GDRIVE_FOLDER="${GDRIVE_FOLDER:-平台产品周会}" GDRIVE_LOCAL_DIR="${GDRIVE_LOCAL_DIR:-/workspace}" bash scripts/sync_gdrive.sh; fi
